editorial.blurb: Milly's crafts exceptional pan-style pizza with a fluffy, light crust and perfectly balanced toppings—just arrive with an advance order in hand.
editorial.insiderTip: Order online early in the morning (around 8am) the day you want pizza, as they sell out quickly; the pre-ordering system lets you know exactly when to pick up.
signatureDishes: Traditional round with pepperoni, red onion and ricotta
